title: Naturally Smoky Mexican Pork Chops Tacos
description: A kid-friendly Mexican dish featuring pork chops with a smoky flavor, this recipe is also vegan-friendly by substituting the traditional pork chops with portobello mushrooms or tofu for a vegan version.

ingredients.name: pork chops
ingredients.notes: or portobello mushrooms/tofu for vegan version

instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together the smoked paprika, lime juice, and olive oil.
Brush the mixture onto both sides of the pork chops.
Season the pork chops with taco seasoning.
Grill the pork chops for 5-6 minutes per side, or until they reach an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Let the pork chops rest for a few minutes before slicing them thinly.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by slicing the pork chops and serving them in the tortillas with salsa, avocado, and cilantro.
